metadata.title: Is the Mensa IQ Test Free? Practice vs Admission
metadata.description: Compare free Mensa practice with supervised admission tests, check what results you receive, and choose the official route for your country.

faq_items.question: Is the Mensa IQ test free?
faq_items.answer: Some official practice activities are free, including the International IQ Challenge and Mensa Norway's informal online test. Practice, home tests and admission services are different products, so check the exact offer rather than assuming every Mensa test is free.

faq_items.question: Can a high Mensa practice score qualify me for membership?
faq_items.answer: No. The International Challenge is practice and does not qualify you. Your national Mensa organisation decides which properly administered tests and prior evidence it accepts.

faq_items.question: Does “online” always mean it is only practice?
faq_items.answer: No. British Mensa currently offers a supervised online admission service with specific eligibility and proctoring requirements. That service is distinct from an unsupervised browser challenge.

faq_items.question: Will a Mensa admission test give me a detailed IQ report?
faq_items.answer: Check the national service's promised output. American Mensa explicitly says its admission test does not provide an IQ score, percentile ranks or a detailed score report; other services must be checked separately.

faq_items.question: Is FermatMind an official Mensa test?
faq_items.answer: No. FermatMind's original 30-question form is independent reasoning practice. Its result is not evidence of Mensa membership eligibility.
